title: Since we started: master merged, the new Browser screens brought in line, the guide tidied

steps.path: Settings → Browser (new on master since we began)
steps.headline: The new Browser settings now look like the rest of Settings.
steps.changed: Small sentence-case labels instead of SPACED CAPITALS; each group (Which browser, On this computer, Sites you've allowed, Saved sign-ins) is one proper card; nothing loose on the popup; Download and "Close the browser" are full-width buttons inside their card; the site count is the small faint number after the label.
steps.notice: Same words and controls; nothing about how the browser works changed.
steps.risk: "On this computer" is a new label I chose for the window and download group; say if you'd word it differently.

steps.headline: Downloading a browser: the progress and Cancel sit inside the card.
steps.changed: The progress line, bar and a full-width Cancel are inside the "On this computer" card instead of a loose grey box. A failed download now reads "The download didn't finish." with the technical reason folded under Details inside the red box (it used to be glued onto the sentence).
steps.notice: The two "are you sure" popups here (switching browsers, signing out of every site) now use the same box as every other small popup.

steps.surface: Browser panel and the chat's hand-off card
steps.path: Chat → the Browser panel (first time) · the card when the assistant hands a step back to you
steps.headline: Two small fixes in the panel and the hand-off card.
steps.changed: The panel's first-time notice puts its "Got it" button inside the notice the shared way. "I can't do this" on the hand-off card is an outlined button, not bare grey text. A failure to open a page now shows as the small red error line, not grey text.
steps.notice: The hand-off card itself keeps its own look: it is in the family of permission prompts you set aside for their own redesign.
steps.risk: Small; nothing else on the panel changed.
